proved: The full essential slab constant equals the supremum over rational symmetric matrices with s3>1, rational intervals and compact finite rational-grid unit-measure product indicators.
Every strict violation of a proposed finite density constant has such a finite rational-grid witness.
The same countable reduction holds with arbitrary affine leakage, after rationalizing affine coefficients on the compact extreme support.
For any measurable output map and any convex TV-lower-semicontinuous output-law functional, the worst cap-one product input equals the supremum over compact finite-grid product indicators.

For D(eta)=sup_I eta(I)/|I|, D is exactly the L-infinity density norm when finite, so the whole output density norm can be extremalized to one sequence of finite-grid product laws rather than interval-by-interval supports.
